title: Spicy Red Shawarma Wrap
description: A flavorful vegan wrap inspired by the classic Middle Eastern shawarma, featuring roasted red peppers and a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper will do

ingredients.name: Carb wrap
ingredients.notes: whole wheat or whole grain wrap

instructions: Place the red bell pepper on a baking sheet and roast for 30-40 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
Remove the pepper from the oven and let it cool. Then peel off the skin, discarding it.
In a small bowl, whisk together the shawarma spice blend and red pepper flakes.
Add the spice blend to the low carb hummus and stir to combine.
Warm the carb wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread the hummus mixture evenly over the wrap.
Slice the roasted red pepper and add it to the wrap, along with the chopped parsley and sliced red onion (if using).
